definition: to be responsible for keeping someone or something safe and well
sentence: Can you look after my cat?

definition: to give someone or something the care they need
sentence: She takes care of her baby.

definition: to stay until someone arrives or something happens
sentence: We wait for the bus.

definition: to speak with someone
sentence: I talk to my friend after school.

definition: to pay attention to a sound or a person speaking
sentence: Listen to the teacher.

definition: to put on clothes to see whether they fit
sentence: Try on the jacket before you buy it.

definition: to give money in exchange for something
sentence: I pay for the bread.

definition: to put something where it belongs after using it
sentence: Put away your toys.

definition: to put something in a bin because you do not want it
sentence: Throw away the empty packet.

definition: to use all of something
sentence: We use up the last of the milk.

definition: to have no more of something left
sentence: We run out of milk.

definition: to eat the first meal of the day
sentence: I have breakfast at seven.

definition: to eat a meal in the middle of the day
sentence: We have lunch at school.

definition: to eat the main meal in the evening or middle of the day
sentence: We have dinner together.

definition: to complete school work at home
sentence: She does homework after school.

definition: to visit shops to buy things
sentence: We go shopping on Saturday.

definition: to stop working for a short rest
sentence: Let us take a break.

definition: to do something more quickly
sentence: Hurry up or we will be late.

definition: to reduce your speed
sentence: Slow down near the school.

definition: to prepare yourself for something
sentence: Get ready for school.

definition: to arrive at the arranged time
sentence: Please be on time for the lesson.

definition: to arrive too late to get on a bus
sentence: I miss the bus and have to wait.

definition: to arrive in time to travel on a bus
sentence: We leave early to catch the bus.

definition: to meet someone by arrangement
sentence: We meet up at the café.

definition: to telephone someone again or return their call
sentence: I will call back after lunch.

definition: to end a telephone call
sentence: Say goodbye before you hang up.

definition: to respond to a telephone that is ringing
sentence: Can you answer the phone?

definition: to reduce the volume of a device
sentence: Turn down the music, please.

definition: to increase the volume of a device
sentence: Turn up the radio so I can hear it.

definition: to write information in the spaces on a form
sentence: Fill in your name and address.

definition: to discover a fact or piece of information
sentence: Let us find out when the shop opens.

definition: develop a problem or stop happening as planned
sentence: Something went wrong with my phone.
